title: Remove CSV rerun original action selection
summary: Removed the separate CSV rerun Original After Proof selection from the desktop launch flow and normalized stale original source policy input so desktop reruns no longer pass original source action flags to Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1.
reason: CSV rerun start could fail immediately when a stale or UI-provided original_policy such as hold_then_delete_after_publish reached the PowerShell entrypoint, which intentionally rejects source cleanup at launch time before final-output proof exists.
behavior_before: CSV rerun launch payloads and preflight requests could include original_policy plus confirm_original_policy and confirm_delete_original. The desktop launch plan forwarded those fields as PowerShell arguments, so a non-keep original policy caused Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1 to exit before work started.
behavior_after: CSV rerun launch uses destination_mode, collision_policy, and confirm_replace_final for verified output placement. The WebView no longer exposes or submits original source action fields, stale API/query values are ignored, launch metadata records source originals as keep, and desktop launch plans omit OriginalPolicy PowerShell arguments.
tests_added: Updated facade, policy, launch-plan, launch-runner, API contract, WebView static, and WebView smoke tests to cover removal of original source policy fields and stale-input normalization.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior WebView Original After Proof selector, API contract fields, launch-plan OriginalPolicy argument forwarding, and matching tests/docs, then rerun the targeted launch and WebView suites.
